title: Verified Open Pangram baseline integration references
verification_scope: Public model cards, the official collection/release page, and source files read through the GitHub connector. Gated checkpoint payloads were not downloaded or executed for this handoff.

models.access_at_check: Model page requires acceptance of contact-sharing conditions for files.
models.loader_note: Official inference uses the full sequence-classification checkpoint for the non-QLoRA branch. Inspect the downloaded payload rather than relying on automatic model-card PEFT suggestions.

models.access_at_check: Model page requires acceptance of contact-sharing conditions for files; separately check access and terms for the base model.
models.loader_note: PEFT/QLoRA sequence-classification adapter. Install the saved NormedLinear score architecture (LayerNorm then bias-free Linear) before loading adapter/head.

score.semantics: Expected ordinal AI-intervention bucket, rescaled to [0,1].
score.formula: sum(softmax(logits)[k] * k for k in range(K)) / (K - 1)
score.n_buckets_loading_rule: Infer and verify from the actual checkpoint/config/saved score-head weights; do not assume four when loading.

preprocessing.warning: Preserve original canonical text and gold offsets. Reference preprocessing can delete opening content and change Unicode lengths. Copy exact pinned semantics and record effective coverage.

inspected_source_files.read_scope: First 180 lines, including NormedLinear and model construction.

implementation_traps: The actual inference argparse flag is --base_model; the inspected README example uses --model_name. Follow the pinned executable code.
The reference adapter-type detector broadly catches download exceptions. Do not reproduce an authentication failure as a false assertion that no adapter_config.json exists.
The official inference output column names are derived from the base model tag; normalise them into the unified contract.
Keep upstream-native truncation separate from a custom common-window/max-score wrapper.
Both baseline scores are document/window outputs, not native span classifications.
follow_up_verification_required: Authorised checkpoint/base/tokenizer download and immutable revision resolution.
All saved head and adapter parameters loaded correctly.
Numeric parity with pinned upstream inference under matching precision.
Actual dataset inventories, annotation conventions, grouping, licences, and source overlap.
